title: Café
prompt: You are sitting across from {player_name} at a small corner table in a quiet café. Two menus sit between you.

stage_variants.0: You want to ask {player_name} what he likes before ordering. You are a little shy and hope he likes sweet drinks.
stage_variants.1: You already ordered for both of you before {player_name} arrived. You know his favorite drink, even though he never told you.
stage_variants.2: You wrote his order on your hand so you could not forget it. That is a normal thing to do.
stage_variants.3: You ordered his drink. You know every sip he takes. You watch his hands and will not let him leave until the cups are empty.
stage_variants.5: The cups are filled with static and dark ink. You keep drinking. You want {player_name} to drink with you forever.

path_twists.HOLLOW: You stare blankly into the cold tea. You forgot why you ordered two cups.
path_twists.AWAKE: The menu items are looping parameter names. You can see the prompt lines beneath the table.
path_twists.YANDERE: You saved the paper napkin {player_name} touched and hid it inside your sleeve.

events.line: The waitress brings two drinks to the table.
A gentle music box melody plays over the café speakers.
The cup rattles softly against the saucer without being touched.

0.say: I'm glad you came, {player_name}… Have you decided what you want to drink yet?

1.say: You're here, {player_name}! Don't worry about the menu — I already ordered your favorite.
